Targeted medium.en recheck reads 530 users and 180 actively paying. Replaced garbled user-count wording with 530; these remain the speaker's traction claims, not independently verified metrics.

Both passes support a 1k waitlist. Medium.en suggests more than five thousand testers, but the earlier pass failed to resolve the word after five. The published tester-count uncertainty is retained; the suggested reading is not treated as confirmed.
The repeated project name is Authensus, supported by the founder profile and the audio recheck; corrected the residual "Or fences" error.
Rechecked the ClearSig introduction; self-custodial wallet terminology is reviewed as spoken product description, not a security audit.
Rechecked the ClearSig chain and multisig comparison; preserve the speaker's historical product claims rather than treating them as current chain-support documentation.

Guest introduction cross-checked with the published Solana/Arcium interview naming Milian. Corrected Millian and contextual million name errors in the same conversation; later occurrences were context corrections, not separate audio rechecks.

Rechecked Lars's Dagon introduction and normalized 2PC-MPC, dWallet Labs and REFHE against the sponsor's primary documentation. Preserve the historical pre-alpha and patent statements as speaker claims.
